hero.title: First impressions last so make it count
hero.name: I'm Muhammed Elsayed
hero.description: Welcome to my personal portfolio! Here, you'll find my Front-End projects, along with a showcase of my skills and information about me. I'm passionate about building modern, responsive, and user-friendly web interfaces that not only look great but also provide a seamless user experience. I continuously strive to improve my skills and expertise in React, JavaScript, and web development to deliver innovative and high-quality projects.

about.subtitle: Introduction
about.title: About Me
about.paragraph1: I'm Muhammed, a passionate Frontend Developer with a keen eye for detail and a love for creating beautiful, functional web experiences. With expertise in modern JavaScript frameworks and a strong foundation in UI/UX principles, I transform ideas into responsive, user-friendly applications.
about.paragraph2: My journey in web development has equipped me with the skills to tackle complex challenges and deliver high-quality solutions. I believe in writing clean, maintainable code and constantly learning new technologies to stay ahead in this ever-evolving field.

skills.title: Skills
skills.heading: My Skills

items.responsive: Designing for all screen sizes and devices

fixora.name: Fixora AI
fixora.description: An AI-powered car maintenance platform that simplifies vehicle servicing through intelligent issue diagnosis, online service booking, and technician coordination. Built with React, featuring role-based experiences for customers, technicians, and administrators, API integration, authentication, booking management, and a complete service workflow. Developed the frontend as part of a collaborative graduation project with a dedicated backend team.

athar.name: ATHAR® — Premium Fashion
athar.description: A premium fashion e-commerce experience built around a distinctive visual identity and immersive digital storytelling. Combines sophisticated product presentation, refined layouts, smooth animations, and responsive interactions to create an engaging brand experience across devices. Designed to bring modern fashion aesthetics into an elegant, interactive web interface.

elmatgar.name: Elmatgar — E-Commerce
elmatgar.description: An interactive e-commerce application that enables users to explore products, view product information, and manage their shopping cart. Built with React and JavaScript, using JSON Server as a mock backend to simulate API requests and data operations during development.

wasel.name: Wasel — Shipment Tracking
wasel.description: A React-based shipment tracking application designed to give users a clear view of their delivery information and shipment status. Focuses on organizing tracking details into an intuitive interface, with reusable components and a responsive layout for a consistent experience across devices.

review.name: Review — Blog Website
review.description: A modern, responsive blog website for UX design and digital culture, built around a bold neo-brutalist visual identity. Features a hero section, a latest articles feed with category tags and post details, a sticky trending and categories sidebar, author profile cards with social links, and a community section with testimonials. Built entirely with HTML and CSS, with a focus on strong typography, thick borders, hard shadows, interactive hover effects, and a clean, responsive layout.

plantica.name: PlantiCa — Plant Store
plantica.description: A React-based plant shopping experience that brings plant discovery and online product browsing into one interface. Designed to showcase plants and related offerings through reusable UI components and responsive layouts. Currently focused on the frontend, with backend integration planned for a future stage.

qatma.name: Qatma — Egyptian Home Kitchen
qatma.description: A responsive website for an Egyptian home kitchen, designed to introduce the brand, showcase its food offerings, and create a welcoming online presence. Built with semantic HTML and custom CSS, with a focus on visual consistency, clear content hierarchy, and an accessible browsing experience.

alahly.name: Al Ahly — Interactive Fan Website
alahly.description: A React-based fan website inspired by Al Ahly SC, combining football-themed visuals, interactive UI elements, and frontend animations into an engaging digital experience. Created as a personal project to explore creative interface development, animation techniques, and the presentation of a football club's identity through the web.

elnasser.name: El-Nasser — Medical Laboratory
elnasser.description: A website for a medical laboratory, built to present laboratory services and essential information through a clear, organized interface. Developed using HTML and CSS, with an emphasis on readable content, structured layouts, and straightforward navigation to help visitors find relevant information.

autocare.name: Autocare — Automotive Landing Page
autocare.description: A landing page for an automotive care business, designed to present car maintenance services and establish a clear online brand presence. Built with HTML and CSS, focusing on structured content, service presentation, and a clean, visual layout.
